subject: Film & Cinema
title: François Truffaut: The Critic Who Created
description: A short lesson to help you apply François Truffaut: The Critic Who Created.

hook.text: Truffaut wrote brutal reviews of French cinema. Then he made the films he demanded.

buildup.text: The 400 Blows was autobiographical — a troubled boy running toward the sea and freedom.

discovery.text: Truffaut's warmth and humanism set him apart from the cooler intellectual New Wave style.

twist.text: He and Godard, once close friends, became bitter rivals over politics and art.

climax.text: Truffaut proved criticism and creation aren't opposites — one can fuel the other.

punchline.text: The angriest critic became the gentlest filmmaker.

quiz.question: What was Truffaut's career before directing?
